notes.title: The Localizations Update is here!
notes.notes:
Investigators,

We are constantly scouting for new recruits for the Orwell Project. But, as many of you have legtimately voiced, our surveillance effort would never be able not realize its full potential as long as it didn't include more languages.

This changes today! The Government of The Nation has spared no expense to present you official localizations of the Orwell software in

German
French
Spanish
Russian
Chinese

as well as an unofficial localization in Portuguese (Brazil), put together by some of our most loyal citizens on translate.orwell-game.com. Also, we would like to say thank you to all our citizens who have pointed out [strike]errors[/strike] minor imperfections in the Public Localization Beta, which is hereby concluded. Note that more languages will be added through future updates.

Additionally, the update brings tons improvements our engineers have worked on tirelessly in the recent months, such as a much demanded phone call text speed slider, a brand new [strike]hack effect[/strike] intrusion warning, some reworked documents, and much shorter loading times.

Please refer to the full changelog below for a detailled list of improvements and additions.


As always, remain vigilant.
The Orwell Project Administration


Changelog Version 1.3

Content and feature changes
added official localizations for German, French, Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese (change language from settings menu)
added community localization for Portuguese (Brazil) [THANKS TO OUR COMMUNITY ON TRANSLATE.ORWELL-GAME.COM!!]
added a slider for text speed in phone calls
slightly reworked timing of events such as comments by Symes
all documents now dynamically adapt to content
completely reworked the layout of some websites
completely reworked some pictures
slightly changed writing in places
Spoiler episodes 2 & 5: [spoiler]completely reworked the hacking/glitch effect on Thought and in the Orwell system[/spoiler]
Spoiler episodes 5: [spoiler]the ending sequence now features a dark overlay to make it clearer what can be clicked and what cannot[/spoiler]

Technical improvements
greatly reduced loading times for savegames
reduced memory footprint
improved document loading, now loads contents element by element

Bugfixes
phone calls will now correctly maintain their vertical scroll position if the call is still running
overlays no longer freeze after uploading a Datachunk
fixed a sound bug when music was muted during the closing cutscene
fixed tons of typos in the English original text

notes.title: Update to Version 1.2 (Changelog)
notes.notes:
Investigators,

as you may know, over the recent months we have been very busy working on season two of Orwell, Orwell: Ignorance is Strength, which you can wishlist here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/633060/Orwell_Ignorance_is_Strength/

During the development we have solved a lot of issues with the game's technical base which we also want to apply to the original Orwell game. We're releasing these improvements with Orwell 1.2 today!

Most notably we increased the game's performance in terms of image loading times and memory usage, but also fixed a nasty bug that sometimes caused already discovered conflicted datachunks to be displayed as not being discovered, causing some confusion (this mainly occurred during Episode 2). 

Note: Your saved profiles are NOT backwards compatible, which means a 1.2 profile won't necessarily load on a version 1.1 game client. Please update the game on any devices to version 1.2 to avoid running into this issue.

As always you can find the full changelog below.


Stay vigilant,
the Osmotic Studios team


Changelog Version 1.2

Content Changes

added a wishlist screen for Orwell: Ignorance is Strength when quitting the game; this can be disabled in said screen
fixed a variety of inconsistencies in expressions (like "government"/"Government")
fixed a variety of typos
SPOILER EPISODE 1: [SPOILER]changed an adviser commentary in regard to Cassandra being depressive that could be out of context if the player didn't add a datachunk on her attitude before[/SPOILER]
SPOILER EPISODE 2: [SPOILER]prevented that the player could solve the objective on Abraham's profession before having added the datachunk on his students and the number of protests, which would then result in a logical inconsistency[/SPOILER]
SPOILER EPISODE 3: [SPOILER]fixed wrong titles of various people on the defaced Party people website[/SPOILER]
SPOILER EPISODE 5: [SPOILER]added a new commentary in which Catherine warns the player when opening her PC's desktop that further investigating her will have consequences[/SPOILER]
SPOILER EPISODE 5: [SPOILER]harrison.txt will now be displayed on initiate's PC in Episode 5 (it had never been visible before)[/SPOILER]
SPOILER EPISODE 5: [SPOILER]Catherine will now comment every datachunk the player uploads on himself/herself (provided she didn't switch off her PC before)[/SPOILER]
SPOILER EPISODE 5: [SPOILER]Catherine will no longer comment on anything after she switches off her PC[/SPOILER]

Technical Fixes
decreased overall memory usage
improved overall performance and loading times
implemented a skip label to the intro cut scene being displayed when the player presses any key
main menu logo animation now plays more fluidly
added a loading cursor while booting up the game
added a warning if a savegame originates from a newer version than the current client; this only works for future versions of the game though
added different layouts of lines underneath tool icons that get switched according to the currently opened tool
category buttons in the Profiler where there aren't any updates are now disabled
mails can now be scrolled correctly if their content exceeds the Listener window
fixed a bug where the game started with a big cursor for a brief moment on some platforms
fixed a bug where the breadcrumb navigation (Insider) didn't show the whole document path after loading savegames multiple times
fixed a bug that prevented already discovered conflicted datachunks to be shown as discovered in the datachunk information window of their counterparts if those datachunks were on a website that was updated several times (this could occur mainly on the Thought website in Episode 2)
fixed a bug that some characters had their names displayed as "Unknown Person" in the corresponding Listener bookmarks when they were actually known
fixed a bug of wrong spacing between insider bookmarks
fixed a bug that led to too much space at the bottom of some websites
fixed an issue where a text box or image outline of a chunk was highlighted on hover, before hovering the actual chunk itself (the box is always a bit larger than the chunk)
fixed a bug where images on Insider devices were not displayed correctly when opening documents for the first time
fixed a savegame bug which could occur when the day was completed while an adviser commentary was still waiting to be displayed
fixed a bug that sometimes led to datachunk boxes not fitting their text in Listener calls after loading a savegame
SPOILER EPISODE 5: [SPOILER]fixed a bug where the number of remaining datachunk uploads weren't correct when loading a savegame at a certain point in the game[/SPOILER]
SPOILER EPISODE 5: [SPOILER]fixed a bug where the "uploads remaining" label was displayed after loading a game even though there weren't any uploads left[/SPOILER]
SPOILER EPISODE 5: [SPOILER]fixed a display bug of the datachunks on the Player Evaluation website[/SPOILER]

Known Issues
savegames are NOT backwards compatible (1.2 savegames do not run on 1.1 or lower clients); there are no warnings being displayed in version 1.1 or lower
Linux: blur shaders have been disabled throughout the game

notes.title: The Rewind Update, IGF, GDC & PAX East!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25928706/1e638892fcf6248aeaed178c4c19e0529349f9e4.png
Hello investigators,

Today we are excited to release a brand new update for Orwell, an update that introduces one of the most requested features we've had from you all!

The Rewind Update will allow all players who have completed the game to "rewind" their save to the beginning of any chosen day, erasing all choices and allowing them to continue and explore other paths. Want to see how things pan out in day three if you made some other choices? Simply select day 3 from the menu and it's almost as if Symes has accidentally deleted all the Datachunks you submitted in days three, four and five!

To access the Episode Selection feature, you will need to access the Profile Options area. The Episode selection button will be locked until you have completed the game at least once, however after completion, it will be available for all new and existing profiles. Any unlocked episode is colored while the rest is grayed out. Click on the episode you want to revert your progress to, then click "Load Episode" and confirm.

Be aware that loading a previous episode PERMANENTLY reverts your progress to the beginning of that episode. This cannot be undone, so make sure you are willing to revert your save before doing so!

We know that the update has taken quite some time. Messing around with save games is never an easy task for developers, so the team at Osmotic has been taking their time to ensure it is done correctly. Initial testing shows that everything is operational, however they may be some fringe cases with some problems. Please report those cases in the Steam forums, so we can make sure that they don't slip through the cracks.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25928706/ddb310b9f2e53e7e78958b969c8ce6abf99f31e8.png

In other news, Osmotic and Surprise Attack Games will be attending GDC 2017, where Osmotic will be hosting an Orwell booth in the IGF Finalist area. We are honoured to be up for the Excellence in Narrative Award, and we can't wait to meet all the devs that will be attending! If you are going to the show, make sure you stop on by and meet the team!

During next week, DRM-free fans can pick up a copy of Orwell on on other stores! The build will be on parity with the Steam build, so if you have some friends who want to hide from the prying eyes of DRM, make sure you let them know.

Finally, Surprise Attack Games will be heading along to PAX East, and will be showcasing Orwell alongside their other titles. You can find them in the PAX Aus Roadshow area, marked clearly in the show guide, and a giant sign above the booth on the show floor. Make sure you head along and show your support if you're making it out to Boston this year!

notes.title: Orwell nominated at SXSW and update to Version 1.0.6236
notes.notes:
Investigators,

Orwell is nominated for the Matthew Crump Cultural Innovation Award at SXSW 2017 alongside That Dragon, Cancer and 1979 Revolution: Black Friday and others, which is a big honor for us! Thanks so much for making this possible!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25928706/6c06a626fe5db4bccafba0e77a3c69deed57c50b.png

Also we have just updated the game to Version 1.0.6236 across all platforms, which is mainly intended to add free window resizing and fix various crashes and instabilities. You can find patchnotes below.

Please note that this patch doesn't include the Episode Selection feature yet. The feature will most likely be released with a February update.

Stay vigilant!
Your Osmotic Studios Team


Patchnotes Version 1.0.6236

Content Fixes
Catherine no longer shows up as "Unknown person" in the Profiler.
Added an additional datachunk to clarify who the "Unknown person" related to Josef Langley is.
Fixed some typos.

Technical Fixes
The game window can now be resized freely in windowed mode.
Fixed various startup crashes.
Fixed a crash that could occur right after 100% of savegame loading.
Fixed various stalls (that also could crash the application) while loading or playing.
Fixed brief CPU stall when starting to load a profile, just before the loading circle switches to the grey 0% state.
Fixed a bug that stopped the loading of a savegame, which was created after starting a new chat / call and before the first message was displayed.
Fixed wrong cursor scaling behavior.
Fixed a bug where profile updates were skipped.
Fixed a bug which led to blurry outlines for chunk boxes when using ultra wide resolutions.
Fixed a bug where parts of the UI (top and bottom) were outside the game window when using certain aspect ratios.
Fixed a bug which led to big chunk icons at the cursor when using ultra wide screen setups.
Can no longer open the ingame menu while the episode label is still being displayed.
Mac: No longer stretches the UI incorrectly when maximizing the window.
[strike]Win: Is now a x86/64-bit universal application.[/strike]

notes.title: Update to Version 1.0.6180
notes.notes:
Investigators,

once again we pushed an update to fix some issues with Orwell. Please find the detailed patch notes below.

Be diligent,
The Osmotic Studios Team


Changelog Version 1.0.6180.31751

Content Fixes
Added two missing portraits, which were shown as "anonymous" in the profiler after the corresponding datachunk had been uploaded.
A wrong date in the epilogue has been corrected.
Technical Fixes
Loading of document images reworked, should be faster and more stable now. This might resolve issues for players reporting missing images in documents.
Fixed a bug where the button "Next Day" in the debriefing could be triggered several times, which could cause one or multiple episodes to be skipped and/or break the savegame.
Fixed a crash / game stalling that could occur while loading a profile.
Fixed a minor visual glitch that could cause the "Your registration is now complete" to be invisible after creating a new profile.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6174 now live
notes.notes:
Investigators,

we just updated Orwell for you. This patch fixes a lot of the issues you have reported us, most importantly a game crash that could occur for some players in Episode 5, as well a bug that prevented images from loading correctly. You can find the the full patchnotes below.

Stay vigilant!
The Osmotic Studios Team


Changelog Version 1.0.6174.29260

Content Fixes
•	Slightly changed conditions by which the epilogue outcomes are determined.
•	Messaging bookmarks in the Insider tool are now labeled “Chat” rather than “Message”, and now have the name of the conversation partner instead of “Message History.”
•	Juliet’s updated browser history is now a history file type instead of a text file type.
•	Fixed a bug that prevented a document on Insider device in Episode 5 from showing up.
•	Fixed some spelling and wording mistakes.

Technical Fixes
•	Fixed a crash / game stalling in Episode 5.
•	Fixed a bug where images on Insider documents weren't loaded correctly for some players.
•	Fixed a bug where the wrong tabs were opened after reloading a profile that had previously completed the game.
•	Fixed a bug where content tabs were opened but no document was displayed.
•	Fixed a bug where the Cassandra’s name Datachunk would show up in a wrong color.
•	Now resizes chat bubbles when a speaker's name gets updated which could previously cause texts to overlap.
•	Minor performance optimizations.
